editorial:
Imagine landing in old Ireland where everyone is terrified of the woods and hates wolves. You follow Robyn, a girl who wants to make her strict father proud by helping him hunt the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she meets Mebh, a wild girl who can actually turn into a wolf when she sleeps. The vibe is like a magical fairy tale that feels alive and breathing. You will love how the art style changes from the stiff, grey city to the bright, messy, and colorful forest. It feels like a giant painting coming to life right in front of you.

What really makes this work is the bond between the two girls and the way the action picks up toward the end. The story moves quickly and keeps you cheering for the wolves. While some of the adults are a bit one-dimensional, the heart of the story is gold. You should definitely watch this with your family.
endingExplained: In the end, Robyn and Mebh lead a huge pack of wolves to fight back against the town's soldiers. They manage to save the wolf family and show the town that wolves are not monsters. Robyn's father finally realizes he was wrong and helps them. The movie wraps up with the town living in peace with nature, and Robyn is free to be herself and stay friends with Mebh.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves beautiful art and stories about friendship.
